description: A line-level input stage for the Submit chain: up to ten times gain with soft clipping, a fader, mute and one effects loop

params.text: Multiplies the input by 1 to 10 before the soft clipper, to bring line-level gear up to modular level
Sets how much of the channel, taken after the fader, goes to the FX send outputs
Sets the channel level, after the gain stage and its soft clipper
Silences the channel, and with it the effects send and the return that send was scaling

inputs.text: The left audio input, taken at line level
The right audio input; it follows the left input when unpatched
Ducks the channel: 10V silences it and 0V leaves it alone, scaling the fader in between
Silences the channel while the voltage here is above 1V
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the left output at the level it arrives
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the right output at the level it arrives
The left return of the effects loop, added to the main mix scaled by the FX1 knob
The right return of the effects loop; it follows the left return when unpatched

outputs.text: The left main mix: the channel, the chain input and the return
The right main mix: the channel, the chain input and the return
The left effects send: the channel at the FX1 setting, plus the matching send chain input
The right effects send: the channel at the FX1 setting, plus the matching send chain input

notes: the return jacks are multiplied by the FX1 knob, so an effect patched into the loop is not heard until FX1 is raised
the gain stage soft-clips above 5V rather than clipping hard, so pushing GAIN past the peak lamp thickens the sound instead of tearing it

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.9:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left return.
